kebab_example: aliyun smartag update-probe-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --sag-id sag-0000 --sn sag0000 --probe-task-id probe-0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProbeTask

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SAG instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
parameters.name: sag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: sn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the probe task
parameters.name: probe_task_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the probe task
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The protocol of the probe task. Valid values:

ICMP
TCP
HTTP

Tasks that probe private networks support only ICMP and TCP
parameters.help_zh:
拨测任务协议。取值：

ICMP。
TCP。
HTTP。

私网拨测仅支持ICMP和TCP协议
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The domain name that is probed by the task.

If the protocol of the probe task is ICMP or TCP, set the value to the IP address or domain name of the service that you want to probe. If the protocol of the probe task is HTTP, set the value to the URL of the service that you want to probe
parameters.help_zh:
拨测任务目的域名。

对于ICMP、TCP协议类型的拨测，取值为目的服务的IP或域名；对于HTTP协议类型的拨测，取值为目的服务的URL
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The port that is probed by the task.

This parameter is required if the protocol of the probe task is TCP. Ignore this parameter if the protocol of the probe task is not TCP
parameters.help_zh:
拨测协议端口号。

对于TCP协议类型的拨测必填，其他协议不填值
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The number of probe packets transmitted by the probe task per minute.

Valid values: 1 to 60.

This parameter is required if the protocol of the probe task is ICMP. Ignore this parameter if the protocol of the probe task is not ICMP
parameters.help_zh:
拨测协议每分钟发包数。

取值范围：1~60。

对于ICMP协议类型的拨测必填，其他协议不填值
parameters.name: packet_number

parameters.help_en:
The source address of the probe task.

This parameter is required if the task probes private networks
parameters.help_zh:
私网拨测源地址。

对于私网类型的拨测必填
parameters.name: probe_task_source_address

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the probe task. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用拨测任务。取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: enable
